category: Analyse Root Causes of AI Vulnerabilities (RV)
subcategory_text: Analyse root causes of remediated AI vulnerabilities (data quality, training-procedure gaps, missing guardrails, prompt-design flaws, supply-chain issues) and feed improvements back into the SDLC.
implementation_examples: Root-cause jailbreaks to missing input sanitisation
Identify training-data quality gaps that contributed to harmful outputs
Track root-cause findings as inputs to model-card updates
assessment_objectives: Determine whether root-cause analysis is performed on AI vulnerabilities.
Determine whether systemic improvements are implemented after analysis.
